description: Public retrieval/answerability benchmark over the fictional Northwind corpus. Answerable cases name the document and one or more verbatim evidence phrases; a retrieved chunk is relevant if it comes from that document and contains any evidence phrase. Unanswerable cases are plausible questions that no document answers.
